tooltip.essentialcraft5.mru_converter.en: Turns MRU into Forge Energy (FE), or into Botania mana when Botania is installed, and pushes it into the blocks touching it
tooltip.essentialcraft5.mru_converter.zh: 把 MRU 换成能量（FE），装了植物魔法时也能换成它的魔力，推给贴着它的方块

tooltip.essentialcraft5.mru_converter.ra.en: Converts up to %1$s MRU per tick into %2$s FE
tooltip.essentialcraft5.mru_converter.ra.zh: 每刻最多换 %1$s MRU，出 %2$s FE

tooltip.essentialcraft5.mru_converter.in.en: Uses no MRU: makes %s FE per tick

tooltip.essentialcraft5.creative.infinit.en: Pushes Forge Energy (FE) or Botania mana into the blocks touching it
tooltip.essentialcraft5.creative.infinit.zh: 推给贴着它的方块：能量（FE）或植物魔法的魔力

gui.essentialcraft5.mru_converter.status.en: Sending to the blocks around it
None of the six blocks touching it can take energy right now (full ones don't count). It stops once a second's worth is stored and uses no more MRU
gui.essentialcraft5.mru_converter.status.zh: 贴着它的六个面没有收得下能量的方块（满了的也算没有）。攒满 1 秒的量它就停下，不再吃 MRU

gui.essentialcraft5.mru_converter.status.en: None of the six blocks touching it is taking mana right now: a full mana pool, or a runic altar or terrestrial agglomeration plate without a recipe on it, takes none. It stops once a second's worth is stored and uses no more MRU
gui.essentialcraft5.mru_converter.status.zh: 贴着它的六个面没有正在收魔力的方块：魔力池满了、符文祭坛和泰拉凝聚板没摆配方时都不收。攒满 1 秒的量它就停下，不再吃 MRU

gui.essentialcraft5.mru_converter.status.en: Put a Bound Gem linked to an MRU source in the gem slot
gui.essentialcraft5.mru_converter.status.zh: 宝石槽里放一颗绑在 MRU 源上的绑定宝石

gui.essentialcraft5.mru_converter.status.en: This converter doesn't make this kind right now; try the other mode button
gui.essentialcraft5.mru_converter.status.zh: 这台转换器现在不出这一种，点另一个模式按钮试试

gui.essentialcraft5.mru_converter.status.en: Mana mode needs Botania. Click Energy to output energy instead
gui.essentialcraft5.mru_converter.status.zh: 魔力模式要装植物魔法；点「能量」改出能量

gui.essentialcraft5.mru_converter.status.en: At most %s of your converters work at the same time
gui.essentialcraft5.mru_converter.status.zh: 你同时最多有 %s 台转换器在工作

gui.essentialcraft5.mru_converter.status.en: The earliest placed ones go first; break one and this one takes over within a few seconds
gui.essentialcraft5.mru_converter.status.zh: 最早放下的那几台优先；拆掉一台，几秒内就轮到它

gui.essentialcraft5.mru_converter.status.en: Nobody placed this converter by hand, so it won't work. Break it and place it again yourself
gui.essentialcraft5.mru_converter.status.zh: 这台转换器不是玩家亲手放下的，不会工作；拆下来自己重新放一次

gui.essentialcraft5.mru_converter.mode.e.en: Energy (FE): pushed into touching blocks that take energy; cables can pull it too
gui.essentialcraft5.mru_converter.mode.e.zh: 能量（FE）：推给贴着的、收能量的方块，电缆也能从这里抽

gui.essentialcraft5.mru_converter.mode.m.en: Mana (Botania): pushed into touching mana pools, mana spreaders and other blocks that are taking mana
gui.essentialcraft5.mru_converter.mode.m.zh: 魔力（植物魔法）：推给贴着的魔力池、魔力发射器这些正在收魔力的方块

gui.essentialcraft5.mru_converter.mode.s.en: Click to switch; whatever is still in the buffer is cleared
gui.essentialcraft5.mru_converter.mode.s.zh: 点一下切换；缓存里还没送出去的会清掉

gui.essentialcraft5.mru_converter.output.en: Average sent per tick over the last second
gui.essentialcraft5.mru_converter.output.zh: 近 1 秒平均每刻送出去多少

gui.essentialcraft5.mru_converter.output.en: Converts up to %s MRU per tick

gui.essentialcraft5.mru_converter.buffer.en: Converted but not sent yet. Once a second's worth is stored, it uses no more MRU
gui.essentialcraft5.mru_converter.buffer.zh: 换好、还没送出去的。攒满 1 秒的量就不再吃 MRU

gui.essentialcraft5.mru_converter.infini.en: Outputs as much as converting %s MRU per tick would
gui.essentialcraft5.mru_converter.infini.zh: 按每刻换 %s MRU 的量输出
